239

Called Meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas December 08, 1882

Hon W A Taylor Mayor Presiding

Roll call present alderman Hartz Kinney
Schuber Radkey & Teuppertz absent aldermen Laurance Bruggerhoff Horten Park & Wilson A
fine of one Dollar was entered against Aldermen Laurance Bruggerhoff Horten Park and
Wilson for non attendance at this meeting

Alderman Schuber moved a call of the
council motion adopted and the marshal
sent after the absentees

Alderman Kinney moved that the
Council take a recess until a quorum was present or the Marshal reported from the
absentees

Marshal Kirk reported that he could
not find any of the absent aldermen

Alderman Radkey moved that the
council adjourn motion adopted

D L Dunrell
City Clerk
